relations: The guinea pig rests on a folded white towel placed directly on the piano keys.
A person's hands hover over the keys, poised to press them.
Pressing the keys may cause the towel and the resting guinea pig to shift slightly.
The towel acts as a soft barrier between the animal and the hard piano keys.
